set -o pipefail && mkdir -p output &&
#if $omero_instance_type.omero_instance == 'priv' and $test_username != "" export OMERO_USER='$test_username' && export OMERO_PASSWORD='$test_password' && #end if
python '$__tool_directory__/idr_download_by_ids.py'
#if $omero_instance_type.omero_instance == 'priv' omero #set $sel = $omero_instance_type.image_ids #if $sel.selection == 'dataset' --dataset $sel.id_dataset_omero #else --image_ids '$sel.id_spec' #end if
#set $reg = $omero_instance_type.image_region --mode $reg.mode #if $reg.mode == 'plane' -z $reg.z_section #if str($reg.channel).strip() -c '$reg.channel' #end if -t $reg.frame #elif $reg.mode == 'stack' #if str($reg.tile).strip() --tile '$reg.tile' #end if -c '$reg.channel' -t $reg.frame #else --hypercube #end if
#if $omero_instance_type.original --original #end if @HOST_PORT@
#elif $omero_instance_type.omero_instance == 'idr' #set $q = $omero_instance_type.query #if $q.type == 'image' image '$q.id_spec' #elif $q.type == 'annotation' annotation '$q.value' '$q.object_type' #else bulk '$q.id_file' #end if #end if
-o output 2>&1 | tee '$log'
#if $zip && tar -czf '$output_tar' output #end if

tool.help:
@SECURITY_DISCLAIMER@ **What it does**
This tool allows users to fetch images and annotations (tables and key-value pairs) directly from the [Image Data Resource (IDR)](https://idr.openmicroscopy.org).
For Zarr images, the tool provides links to their S3/HTTPS storage locations, together with a link for NGFF validation. Other image file formats are downloaded as original files, up to a maximum of 20 files; if more than 20 files are selected, only links are provided.
Images stored in OMERO can be fetched as single-plane (YX), stack (ZYX), hypercube TIFF (ZCTYX), or as the original files.
**Downloading from IDR**
Choose one of the following ways to select images:
- **As text**: Enter a single image ID, or a space-separated list of image IDs (for example, `54321 54322 54323`). - **By IDR annotation**: Select an `OMERO.table` or key-value annotation associated with an image, a screen/plate, or a project/dataset.
**Downloading from a private OMERO server**
Enter the server hostname and indicate whether it uses a secure (SSL) connection. Images can be selected by image ID or by OMERO dataset ID. If a dataset ID is selected, all images in that dataset are downloaded.
Then choose what to download:
- **Export - Plane**: Downloads a single plane defined by the channel name, z-plane, and time point. If no channel is specified, the first channel is used. The output is a 2D image (YX). - **Export - Stack**: Downloads all z-planes for a single channel and time point as a TIFF file. The output is a 3D image (ZYX). - **Export - Hypercube**: Downloads all dimensions as a TIFF file. The output is a 5D image (ZCTYX). - **Original**: Downloads the file exactly as originally uploaded to OMERO, rather than exporting it.
For all options except **Original**, the download can be limited to a tile specified as `x,y,width,height` in pixels, where `x,y` is the upper-left corner.
**Output**
A **log** file lists the downloaded images and any warnings or errors.
The downloaded images are returned either as a **tarball** containing all downloaded images (default; recommended for many images) or as a **collection** of individual images when “Download images in a tarball?” is set to **No**.
The collection option is recommended only for a small number of images.
